angle: A randomized controlled trial reports its primary outcome, upending prior expectations about an existing treatment.
A high-profile paper is retracted after an institutional investigation finds data manipulation.
An unreviewed preprint sparks widespread attention and debate before peer review concludes.
Independent labs fail to reproduce a landmark finding, prompting a field-wide reckoning.
A well-powered study reports a null result that contradicts a widely promoted hypothesis.
A meta-analysis pools dozens of trials to settle a long-running disagreement over effect size.
Researchers establish a new laboratory organism that opens previously inaccessible experimental questions.
A science mission launches to study a target no spacecraft has visited before.
A probe arrives at its destination and begins orbital observations after years of cruise.
A lander sets down on a planetary surface and returns its first images and telemetry.
A capsule carrying extraterrestrial samples parachutes to Earth and enters curation.
A new observatory releases its first-light images, revealing capabilities beyond prior instruments.
Spectroscopy identifies a molecule in an exoplanet atmosphere, narrowing habitability questions.
Detectors register a merger event that tests theories of compact-object physics.
A spacecraft transmits anomalous data that engineers and scientists race to diagnose.
A funding agency decides the fate of an aging but productive science mission.
A research team completes a traverse across an ice sheet, collecting unprecedented field data.
A submersible dive surveys an unexplored trench and documents new species.
A rapid-assessment expedition catalogues species in a threatened, poorly studied habitat.
A drilling team extracts an ice core that extends the climate record further back in time.
Scientists deploy instruments on an restless volcano and capture a precursory signal.
Explorers map a newly accessible cave system and find preserved paleontological material.
A field crew unearths a fossil assemblage that reframes an evolutionary transition.
A remote research station faces closure, threatening a decades-long ecological monitoring record.
A national facility opens with instrumentation unavailable elsewhere, drawing visiting researchers.
An accident at a research laboratory triggers a review of safety protocols and oversight.
A university upgrades containment facilities to enable work on a dangerous pathogen.
A critical instrument fails, halting experiments across many labs that depend on it.
An internal audit of a large lab's records finds inconsistent data practices.
A student-led side project yields an unexpected observation that reshapes a lab's direction.
Volunteers analyzing open data spot a phenomenon professional surveys missed.
An experiment aimed at one question produces an accidental result with broader implications.
Genetic material from old remains rewrites a population history previously inferred from artifacts.
A materials team reports a compound with properties predicted but never before realized.
A new catalyst achieves a reaction under far milder conditions than industry standard.
A quantum device demonstrates an error-correction result that changes scaling projections.
A fusion experiment reports a plasma milestone that advances the case for net energy.
A lab-scale cell chemistry promises longer life or safer operation than commercial alternatives.
Researchers demonstrate a fabrication route that could extend chip scaling.
A machine-learning system produces a scientific result later validated by conventional methods.
A major funder awards a large grant to a consortium tackling a longstanding problem.
A budget reduction forces cancellation of a research program and scatters its team.
A funding decision draws criticism over transparency and peer-review process.
A private donation endows a research institute or initiative with unusual independence.
A university and company announce a joint research agreement with contested terms.
A new publishing policy changes how federally funded research must be released.
A consortium releases a massive dataset that other scientists can mine for new questions.
A platform launches to help labs register designs and share analysis code by default.
A long-running field station loses funding, jeopardizing longitudinal environmental data.
An expert panel issues recommendations that could reshape research priorities or regulation.
